title: 'The Interview': Rick Steves Refuses To Get Cynical About the World

sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.zh: 我在清晨4点半打电话给总统，他接听了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空度过的七个十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费产品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最好的球队。

sentences.zh: 我每天都使用不同的首字母单词。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，持续帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这里是《访谈》。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: The minute I left university, I put on a backpack and went to see the world.
sentences.zh: 我一离开大学，就背上背包去看看世界。

sentences.en: I climbed the Andes in Ecuador.
sentences.zh: 我攀登了厄瓜多尔的安第斯山脉。

sentences.en: I taught English in Cambodia.
sentences.zh: 我在柬埔寨教英语。

sentences.en: I spent months visiting monasteries in Tibet.
sentences.zh: 我在西藏的寺庙里度过了几个月。

sentences.en: It was the most transformative period of my life.
sentences.zh: 这是我一生中最具变革意义的时期。

sentences.en: Lately, though, I feel like my travel mojo is gone.
sentences.zh: 不过最近，我觉得我的旅行魔力消失了。

sentences.en: Instead of traveling to discover, I now travel to retreat.
sentences.zh: 我不再为了探索而旅行，而是为了隐退而旅行。

sentences.en: I'm often overwhelmed by the demands of daily life.
sentences.zh: 我经常被日常生活的种种要求压得喘不过气来。

sentences.en: So when it's time for vacation, I choose a destination that doesn't ask too much of me and I don't give much back.
sentences.zh: 所以当假期来临时，我会选择一个对我要求不高、我也不用付出太多的目的地。

sentences.en: Rick Steves has been helping millions of people, including people like me, expand their travel horizons since he was in his 20s.
sentences.zh: 瑞克·斯特夫斯从20多岁起就一直在帮助数百万人（包括像我这样的人）拓宽他们的旅行视野。

sentences.en: The prolific guidebook writer and beloved PBS personality believes that travel can make not only the world a better place, but you a better person.
sentences.zh: 这位多产的旅行指南作家和深受爱戴的公共广播公司（PBS）名人坚信，旅行不仅能让世界变得更美好，还能让你成为一个更好的人。

sentences.en: He's 69 now, but his upcoming book is about how it all began, with a trip he took after university like me.
sentences.zh: 他现在69岁了，但他即将出版的新书讲述了一切是如何开始的，那是像我一样在他大学毕业后的一次旅行。

sentences.en: It's called On the Hippie Trail, and it's the journal entries he wrote as he traveled the 3,000 miles from Istanbul to Kathmandu in 1978.
sentences.zh: 这本书名为《在嬉皮士小径上》，记录了他在1978年从伊斯坦布尔到加德满都旅行3000英里时写下的日记。

sentences.en: It's full of the joy of exploration and discovery.
sentences.zh: 它充满了探索与发现的喜悦。

sentences.en: And I wanted to talk to him to relearn how to feel that sense of communion with the world.
sentences.zh: 我想和他聊聊，以便重新学会如何感受那种与世界的共鸣感。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with travel guru Rick Steves.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与旅行大师瑞克·斯特夫斯的对话。

sentences.en: I was reading your newest book, which are the diaries of a trip that you took in 1978 when you were 23 years old on what was called the Hippie Trail.
sentences.zh: 我正在读你的新书，这是你1978年23岁时踏上被称为“嬉皮士小径”之旅的日记。

sentences.en: When you re-read those diaries, what did it evoke in you when you looked at that 23-year-old with the hindsight of age now?
sentences.zh: 当你重新阅读这些日记时，带着如今岁月的后见之明，看着那个23岁的自己，它唤起了你怎样的回忆？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What did that make you feel?
sentences.zh: 这让你有什么感觉？

sentences.en: I forgot I wrote that journal for 40 years.
sentences.zh: 我把那本写过日记的事忘得一干二净，足足40年。

sentences.en: I mean, I didn't forget.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不是忘了它存在。

sentences.en: I never looked at it.
sentences.zh: 我只是从未看过它。

sentences.en: It was just in a box.
sentences.zh: 它就躺在一个箱子里。

sentences.en: And then during COVID, I read it.
sentences.zh: 然后在疫情期间，我读了它。

sentences.en: First of all, what kind of 23-year-old would write a 60,000-word journal while on a hippie bus going from Istanbul to Kathmandu?
sentences.zh: 首先，到底是什么样的23岁年轻人，会在从伊斯坦布尔开往加德满都的嬉皮士大巴上，写下一篇6万字的日记？

sentences.en: And when I think about that, I was not a travel writer.
sentences.zh: 当我回想起来，我当时并不是什么旅行作家。

sentences.en: I was a piano teacher.
sentences.zh: 我是一名钢琴老师。

sentences.en: I just was writing that for me.
sentences.zh: 我写这些只是为了记录自己。

sentences.en: And when I read it, it was really insightful.
sentences.zh: 当我读它时，发现它真的很有见地。

sentences.en: It might sound immodeSt.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能有点不谦虚。

sentences.en: But one thing I love as a writer is you can't go back to the United States and write it up.
sentences.zh: 但作为一名作家，我喜欢的一点是，你不能回到美国后再去动笔写。

sentences.en: You've got to write it up right there in the humid, buggy reality with all the cacophony of culture all around you.
sentences.zh: 你必须就在那里写，在闷热、虫子乱飞的现实中，周围充斥着各种文化的嘈杂声。

sentences.en: That's where you take your notes, and it's most vivid.
sentences.zh: 那才是你做笔记的地方，也最为生动。

sentences.en: So I was doing that on that hippie trail ride, sitting there, watching the needle bend as it went into my travel partner's arm at the border so he could get his shot,
sentences.zh: 所以我在那趟嬉皮士大巴的旅程中就是这么做的，坐在那里，看着边境上针头扎进我旅行伙伴手臂里，好让他打针，

sentences.en: because he didn't have it on his yellow international certificate of vaccination.
sentences.zh: 因为他的黄色国际疫苗接种证书上没有这项记录。

sentences.en: That's a vivid moment to think that you're stopped on the border between Iran and Afghanistan, and glad you don't have that needle going into your arm.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，你被拦在伊朗和阿富汗的边境上，庆幸针头没有扎进你的手臂，这是一个多么生动的时刻。

sentences.en: This was a vivid trip.
sentences.zh: 这是一次极其生动的旅行。

sentences.en: So reading this book really brought me back, because when I was 23, I went on my own version of the hippie trail.
sentences.zh: 所以读这本书真的把我带回了过去，因为在我23岁时，我也踏上了属于我自己的嬉皮士小径之旅。

sentences.en: And I went to different countries.
sentences.zh: 我去了不同的国家。

sentences.en: I went to Asia.
sentences.zh: 我去了亚洲。

sentences.en: But the thing that changed the course of my life happened there.
sentences.zh: 但那个改变我人生轨迹的事情就发生在那里。

sentences.en: I was in Vietnam, and it was the 20-year anniversary of the fall of Saigon.
sentences.zh: 当时我在越南，正值西贡沦陷20周年纪念日。

sentences.en: And I was not interested in journalism in any way, shape, or form.
sentences.zh: 我对新闻业可以说是毫无兴趣，毫无任何形式的沾边。

sentences.en: And I happened to be at this bar called Apocalypse Now, which is named, of course, after the film.
sentences.zh: 而我恰好去了这家名为“现代启示录”的酒吧，当然，这个名字是根据那部电影取得的。

sentences.en: And I happened to run into a whole bunch of journalists that were there to commemorate the 20th anniversary that had covered the war.
sentences.zh: 我恰好遇到了许多曾报道过那场战争、前来纪念20周年纪念日的记者。

sentences.en: And I met them and hung out with them for a while.
sentences.zh: 我遇到了他们，并和他们在一起待了一会儿。

sentences.en: And that was my first exposure to journalism and being a foreign correspondent, which is what ended up being my career.
sentences.zh: 那是我第一次接触新闻业和驻外记者工作，而这最终成了我的职业生涯。

sentences.en: And so it resonated so much reading this, because through the journey, right, not everything ends up changing the course of your life.
sentences.zh: 所以读到这些时我产生了强烈共鸣，因为在整个旅程中，并非所有事情最终都会改变你的人生轨迹。

sentences.en: But the seeds of maybe what you're going to become, you know, you can often find them when you have these incredible experiences.
sentences.zh: 但当你经历这些不可思议的经历时，你往往能找到你未来可能会变成什么样子的种子。

sentences.en: And I just found that to be true reading about 23-year-old Rick Steves.
sentences.zh: 当我读到23岁的瑞克·斯特夫斯时，我发现这千真万确。

sentences.en: Yeah, it is a cumulative thing.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个日积月累的过程。

sentences.en: I mean, these little seeds add up.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些小小的种子会累积起来。

sentences.en: And if you're a good traveler, you're more exposed.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个优秀的旅行者，你就会接触得更多。

sentences.en: You put yourself, you travel with the window down.
sentences.zh: 你会让自己置身其中，敞开窗户去旅行。

sentences.en: Some people, their wisdom is, oh, don't get in on a bus.
sentences.zh: 有些人的生存智慧是，哦，千万别上那种大巴。

sentences.en: It's too crowded.
sentences.zh: 人太多了。

sentences.en: You might get pickpocketed.
sentences.zh: 你可能会遇到扒手。

sentences.en: I love to be on a bus that's so crowded that there's people hanging outside the door when the bus takes off.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢挤那种人满为患、大巴车开动时甚至有人挂在车门外的大巴。

sentences.en: And then they settle in like cornflakes settle into a box, you know.
sentences.zh: 然后大家就像玉米片落入盒子那样安顿下来，你知道的。

sentences.en: And there's always room for one more body.
sentences.zh: 而且总能再容纳一个人。

sentences.en: That's a beautiful, beautiful part of the world that people who are too careful, they miss.
sentences.zh: 那是世界上美丽至极的一部分，而那些过于小心翼翼的人错过了这一切。

sentences.en: But you have to be out.
sentences.zh: 但你必须走出去。

sentences.en: Like you were there at that gathering of journalists on an anniversary.
sentences.zh: 就像你在一个纪念日去参加那个记者聚会一样。

sentences.en: That was a lucky break for you.
sentences.zh: 对你来说那是一次幸运的突破。

sentences.en: And it had a huge impact.
sentences.zh: 它产生了巨大的影响。

sentences.en: It was absolutely serendipitous.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是机缘巧合。

sentences.en: It was juSt...
sentences.zh: 这简直是……

sentences.en: It's serendipity.
sentences.zh: 这就是命运的巧合。

sentences.en: And you got to say yes to serendipity.
sentences.zh: 你必须对这种机缘巧合说“好”。

sentences.en: First of all, you got to put yourself in a situation where you stumble onto serendipity.
sentences.zh: 首先，你得把自己置于一种能够偶遇机缘巧合的环境中。

sentences.en: Little moments happen.
sentences.zh: 微小的时刻总会发生。

sentences.en: And these little moments, as a travel teacher, I draw from for the rest of my days.
sentences.zh: 而作为一名旅行老师，这些微小的时刻成为我余生汲取养分的源泉。

sentences.en: Travel teacher.
sentences.zh: 旅行老师。

sentences.en: Is that how you see yourself?
sentences.zh: 这就是你如何看待自己的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: For many, many years when I cross the border, they say, what's your occupation?
sentences.zh: 很多很多年里，当我过境时，他们会问，你的职业是什么？

sentences.en: You know, and I'd say, teacher.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我会说，老师。

sentences.en: My classroom is the road.
sentences.zh: 我的教室就是路途。

sentences.en: I teach people on buses or I teach them through my books or with my TV shows.
sentences.zh: 我在大巴上教导人们，或者通过我的书和电视节目教导他们。

sentences.en: But for me, that's what I am is...
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，这就是我……

sentences.en: I've only had two jobs and they're both teaching things I love.
sentences.zh: 我只做过两份工作，它们都是在教我热爱的事物。

sentences.en: I taught piano and I teach travel now.
sentences.zh: 我教过钢琴，现在我教旅行。

sentences.en: And it was a big emotional deal for me to make the transition.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，实现这种转变是一个重大的情感抉择。

sentences.en: I remember I had to decide in 1980, when I was 25 years old, am I going to be a piano teacher or a travel teacher?
sentences.zh: 我记得在1980年，我25岁的时候，我必须做出决定：我是要当一名钢琴老师，还是一名旅行老师？

sentences.en: And I had a recital hall in my little town.
sentences.zh: 我的小镇上有一间演奏厅。

sentences.en: My students were giving recitals and their parents were sitting on boxes of my first self-published edition of Europe Through the Back Door.
sentences.zh: 我的学生们在那里进行演奏会，他们的家长则坐在我第一版自出版图书《走后门看欧洲》的纸箱上。

sentences.en: And my heart was really in the travel more than in the piano teaching.
sentences.zh: 比起教钢琴，我的心其实更倾向于旅行。

sentences.en: And so I gave up my students and I turned my recital hall into a travel lecture hall.
sentences.zh: 所以我放弃了学生，把我的演奏厅变成了一个旅行演讲厅。

sentences.en: And, you know, we had a monthly World Traveler Slide Club.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们有一个月度的世界旅行者幻灯片俱乐部。

sentences.en: It met the first Sunday of every month.
sentences.zh: 它在每个月的第一个星期日聚会。

sentences.en: I had an eight-hour all-day seminar on how to travel skills.
sentences.zh: 我有一场持续整整八小时的关于旅行技巧的研讨会。

sentences.en: That would be a Saturday talk.
sentences.zh: 那是周六的演讲。

sentences.en: And the next day I had a six or seven-hour talk on art, the art of Europe.
sentences.zh: 第二天，我有一场长达六、七小时关于艺术、欧洲艺术的演讲。

sentences.en: And then on Sunday night I had a three-hour talk called Travel Beyond Europe, TBE.
sentences.zh: 然后周日晚上，我有一场三小时的演讲，叫做“超越欧洲旅行”（TBE）。

sentences.en: And that would be Egypt, Morocco, and Turkey, just for the real eager beavers.
sentences.zh: 那是专为那些真正极度热心的旅行者准备的，目的地包括埃及、摩洛哥和土耳其。

sentences.en: And that was when I was a college kid.
sentences.zh: 那是我还在上大学的时候。

sentences.en: And, you know, that would be a way I would make a little money, sell a few of my self-published books.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那是我赚点小钱、卖几本自己出版的书的方式。

sentences.en: But most important, hone my delivery and develop a sixth sense for what are the fears and apprehensions that are troubling people before their trip.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，它磨练了我的表达能力，并培养了一种第六感，能敏锐察觉人们在旅行前会为什么样的恐惧和忧虑所困扰。

sentences.en: I would have everybody fill out a little page that said, what are they really anxious about for their trip?
sentences.zh: 我会让每个人填一小页纸，写下他们在旅行中真正焦虑的是什么。

sentences.en: What are they afraid of?
sentences.zh: 他们害怕什么？

sentences.en: And I learned a lot by that, and I learned a lot by 20 or 30 years of being a tour guide on a bus.
sentences.zh: 通过这些我学到了很多，通过当了20或30年大巴导游，我也学到了很多。

sentences.en: That's where you learn how much of an attention span do people have.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里，你明白了人们的注意力能维持多久。

sentences.en: How many Madonnas and children can they see before they wouldn't walk across the street for a Raphael?
sentences.zh: 他们看过了多少幅圣母子画像，才会对拉斐尔的作品连过马路看一眼的兴趣都没有？

sentences.en: When I think of the trip that I used to do when I was starting my company, I just did around and around Europe in 22 days, it was called.
sentences.zh: 当我想起我刚开始创办公司时所做的旅行，那是一条在欧洲兜兜转转22天的行程，当时被称为这个名字。

sentences.en: And it's the best 3,000 miles that Europe had to offer.
sentences.zh: 那是欧洲所能提供的最好的3000英里旅程。

sentences.en: And, you know, you start the trip, and people are wide-eyed and don't know the drill.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，旅行刚开始时，人们都睁大眼睛，对流程一无所知。

sentences.en: And then you teach them, you create a esprit de corps, you create an understanding that we're a family.
sentences.zh: 然后你教导他们，培养一种团队精神，建立一种“我们是一家人”的共识。

sentences.en: And then you realize that we need to provide context so people know what they're looking at.
sentences.zh: 接着你意识到，我们需要提供背景信息，好让人们知道他们究竟在看什么。

sentences.en: It's just a fun, artful challenge for a tour manager, a tour organizer, a tour guide to recognize this is a big part in the lives of people
sentences.zh: 对于一个旅游经理、旅游组织者、导游来说，这是一个有趣且充满艺术性的挑战，他们要认识到这在人们的生活中占了很大比重——

sentences.en: who have scrimped and saved and dreamed for years to take this trip, and we do it over and over and over again.
sentences.zh: 这些人省吃俭用、梦想了多年才得以进行这次旅行，而我们一遍又一遍地重复着这一切。

sentences.en: And I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: Rick, in those days when you were doing that sort of circumambulation of Europe, what did you learn about Americans abroad?
sentences.zh: 瑞克，当年你在欧洲进行那种环游时，你对在国外的美国人有了什么了解？

sentences.en: Like, what did you see in having these experiences over and over and over again with your countrymen in Europe?
sentences.zh: 比如，在欧洲和你的同胞们一次又一次地经历这些后，你看到了什么？

sentences.en: I had this sense that people were threatened by other cultures that did things well.
sentences.zh: 我有一种感觉，人们会受到那些把事情做得很出色的其他文化的威胁。

sentences.en: And there's this pride in America.
sentences.zh: 美国有一种强烈的自豪感。

sentences.en: And I thought, I remember back then, let's say you're checking in at a hotel, and you have to write down your birthday.
sentences.zh: 我记得当年，比方说你在酒店登记入住，你必须写下你的生日。

sentences.en: And my birthday is May 10, 55, so it's 5, 10, 55.
sentences.zh: 我的生日是1955年5月10日，所以是5、10、55。

sentences.en: And they go, no, it's 10, 5, 55.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，不对，应该是10、5、55。

sentences.en: They put the day before the month.
sentences.zh: 他们把日期写在月份前面。

sentences.en: It's a silly little thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件很小很傻的事情。

sentences.en: But a lot of Americans would be bummed out at that.
sentences.zh: 但许多美国人会对这一点感到沮丧。

sentences.en: They'd draw back, and they'd clench their fist, and they'd think, we fought and died for your freedom and your way of life,
sentences.zh: 他们会退缩，紧握拳头，心想：我们为你们的自由和生活方式战斗并牺牲了，

sentences.en: and I'm not going to sit here and let you tell me that it's not month, day, year.
sentences.zh: 我可不会坐在这里听你说这不是“月、日、年”。

sentences.en: However, Americans are threatened by this, and you've got to tell them, no, they're not saying they're better than you.
sentences.zh: 然而，美国人感到了这种威胁，你必须告诉他们：不，他们不是在说他们比你优秀。

sentences.en: They just do it this way.
sentences.zh: 他们只是这样行事而已。

sentences.en: And, you know, we are not the norm.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们并不是常态。

sentences.en: This is very important.
sentences.zh: 这一点非常重要。

sentences.en: We do kind of lead the world in self-evident and God-given truths, but we are not the norm.
sentences.zh: 我们在那些不言自明和上帝赋予的真理方面确实引领着世界，但我们并不是常态。

sentences.en: And I just love to expose people to examples of things they would never encounter at home.
sentences.zh: 我就是喜欢让人们接触到那些他们在国内永远遇不到的事物的事例。

sentences.en: And then they've got the option to embrace it and enjoy it or say, I tried that, I don't like it, I'm so glad I'm an American.
sentences.zh: 然后他们可以选择去接受它、享受它，或者说：我试过了，我不喜欢，我真高兴我是一个美国人。

sentences.en: That's cool.
sentences.zh: 这挺酷的。

sentences.en: The happiest day of the year for me is the day I return home, and I'm glad I live here.
sentences.zh: 一年中对我来说最快乐的一天，就是我返回祖国的那一天，我很高兴我住在这里。

sentences.en: I would never live anywhere else.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会搬到其他任何地方去住。

sentences.en: But good travel is, culture shock is a constructive thing.
sentences.zh: 但好的旅行，也就是文化冲击，其实是建设性的。

sentences.en: This is a new thing I've been talking about lately.
sentences.zh: 这是我最近一直在谈论的新话题。

sentences.en: Culture shock is constructive.
sentences.zh: 文化冲击具有建设性。

sentences.en: It's the growing pains of a broadening perspective, and it just needs to be curated.
sentences.zh: 它是开阔视野时的阵痛，只需要加以引导。

sentences.en: And so you set up experiences, and then you provide a forum for people to share and compare notes.
sentences.zh: 所以你们会安排各种体验，然后为人们提供一个分享和交流心得的平台。

sentences.en: And we call this reflections times.
sentences.zh: 我们把这称之为反思时间。

sentences.en: And on my ideal tour, I'm not the teacher, I'm just the facilitator.
sentences.zh: 在我的理想旅程中，我不是老师，我只是个引导者。

sentences.en: It's happy hour before dinner, and we were just at a concentration camp memorial.
sentences.zh: 那是晚餐前的欢乐时光，而我们刚参观完一个集中营纪念馆。

sentences.en: Or we were just experiencing how the Dutch are preparing for a rising sea level.
sentences.zh: 或者我们刚刚体验了荷兰人是如何应对海平面上升的。

sentences.en: Or we were just sitting in the city hall in Oslo talking with Norwegians who happily pay more taxes
sentences.zh: 又或者我们坐在奥斯陆的市政厅里，与那些乐意多交税的挪威人交谈

sentences.en: because they see the government as a great way to tackle challenges that should be tackled collectively.
sentences.zh: 因为他们认为政府是解决那些应该集体应对的挑战的好办法。

sentences.en: And let people share their thoughts and their impressions and what they're finding stressful and what they're finding beautiful.
sentences.zh: 让大家分享他们的想法、印象、觉得有压力的事，以及觉得美好的事。

sentences.en: For me, that's very, very rewarding as a teacher.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，作为一名老师，这非常有意义。

sentences.en: It becomes a transformational experience.
sentences.zh: 这变成了一次蜕变般的体验。

sentences.en: And to me, there's two kinds of travel.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，旅行有两种。

sentences.en: There's escape travel, and there's reality travel.
sentences.zh: 一种是逃避式旅行，另一种是现实式旅行。

sentences.en: I want to go home a little bit different, a little less afraid, a little more thankful, a little better citizen of the planet.
sentences.zh: 我希望回家时能变得有点不一样，没那么恐惧，多了一点感恩，成为这个星球上更好的一位公民。

sentences.en: And so that's what you'd say the Rick Steves philosophy is.
sentences.zh: 这就是所谓的Rick Steves哲学。

sentences.en: It's to take something and come back changed for the better by it.
sentences.zh: 也就是通过某种经历，归来时让自己变得更好。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I would temper that by reminding people my beat is Europe.
sentences.zh: 我要补充一点，提醒大家我的主阵地是欧洲。

sentences.en: And I do Europe because it's the biggest market.
sentences.zh: 我选择欧洲是因为它是最大的市场。

sentences.en: It's where my roots are.
sentences.zh: 那里是我的根基所在。

sentences.en: And it's a beautiful springboard to the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 它也是通往世界其他地方的美丽跳板。

sentences.en: My favorite country is India.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的国家是印度。

sentences.en: But I don't teach India.
sentences.zh: 但我不教人怎么游印度。

sentences.en: I teach Europe as the gateway to the world.
sentences.zh: 我把欧洲作为通往世界的门户来教学。

sentences.en: That's a way that, pragmatically, I can reach more people than to talk to the adventurers that are, you know, trekking in Nepal or something like that.
sentences.zh: 从现实角度来看，这样我能接触到更多人，而不是去跟那些在尼泊尔徒步冒险的人对话。

sentences.en: I do want to pick up on this idea of escape travel versus reality travel.
sentences.zh: 我想探讨一下逃避式旅行与现实式旅行这个概念。

sentences.en: That's a really nice framing because I hear you making the case for a particular type of immersive, respectful kind of travel.
sentences.zh: 这个切入点真不错，因为我听出你在倡导一种沉浸式的、尊重的独特旅行方式。

sentences.en: And I don't think it's much of a stretch to say that that's not how most people approach their vacations.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这样说并不夸张：这并不是大多数人度假的方式。

sentences.en: I'm thinking of especially the modern idea of going somewhere simply because you're going to be able to post on social media about it.
sentences.zh: 我特别想到了现代人的这种想法：去某个地方仅仅是为了能在社交媒体上发帖。

sentences.en: What do you think of that approach?
sentences.zh: 你如何看待这种做法？

sentences.en: Well, you know, it seems like it has, but I don't get demoralized by that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，这似乎已经成了一种现象，但我不会因此而泄气。

sentences.en: People have a choice.
sentences.zh: 人们有选择的权利。

sentences.en: You can have La La Land.
sentences.zh: 你可以选择活在梦幻泡影中。

sentences.en: You can go to your grave with a big barbecue apron like a Budweiser beer commercial, you know, that life was good for you and not learn anything.
sentences.zh: 你可以带着印有百威啤酒广告那种大烧烤围裙走进坟墓，觉得这一生过得很不错，却什么也没学到。

sentences.en: And really think you're the center of this planet, which is fine, you know,
sentences.zh: 并且真的觉得自己是这个星球的中心，这也没关系，你知道的，

sentences.en: but I've just got this curiosity to get to know the rest of the world and to contribute in a way that makes the world a better place.
sentences.zh: 但我就是有一股好奇心，想去了解世界其他地方，并为让世界变得更美好贡献一份力量。

sentences.en: And I love these kind of quotes, like Thomas Jefferson wrote, travel makes a person wiser if less happy.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这类名言，比如托马斯·杰斐逊写的：旅行让人变得更睿智，哪怕没那么快乐。

sentences.en: And I've always had this hunger to be more engaged, not necessarily more happy, but more engaged.
sentences.zh: 我一直有一种渴望，想要更多地参与其中，不一定是为了更快乐，而是为了更有参与感。

sentences.en: I always use this anecdote.
sentences.zh: 我总是用这个趣闻来举例。

sentences.en: I was really involved in the Sandinistas and the Contras and all that.
sentences.zh: 我曾经深度参与过桑地诺民族解放阵线和反政府武装之类的事。

sentences.en: That's kind of where I got politicized as far as...
sentences.zh: 我大概就是在那个时候开始有了政治觉悟，关于……

sentences.en: In the 1980s during the civil wars in Central America.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪80年代中美洲内战期间。

sentences.en: Exactly, yeah.
sentences.zh: 完全正确，是的。

sentences.en: And I just felt responsible as an American taxpayer to know.
sentences.zh: 作为一名美国纳税人，我只是觉得我有责任去了解。

sentences.en: I came to a conclusion then that every bullet that flies has my name on it.
sentences.zh: 当时我得出一个结论：每一颗飞过的子弹上都写着我的名字。

sentences.en: And we got to kill innocent people occasionally to be safe.
sentences.zh: 为了保持安全，我们有时不得不杀死无辜的人。

sentences.en: And I'm not idealistic that way.
sentences.zh: 我在这方面并不盲目理想主义。

sentences.en: You got to have a military.
sentences.zh: 你必须得有军队。

sentences.en: And there's collateral damage.
sentences.zh: 这其中会有附带损伤。

sentences.en: But I'm responsible.
sentences.zh: 但我有责任。

sentences.en: And I wanted to get out there in person and see what's going on.
sentences.zh: 我想亲自去实地看看究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: And I started traveling with that in mind.
sentences.zh: 于是我怀着这种心态开始旅行。

sentences.en: And I realized, whoa, this is more complicated than I realized.
sentences.zh: 我意识到，哇，这比我想象的要复杂得多。

sentences.en: And I was very inspired by Archbishop Oscar Romero, this liberation theology stuff.
sentences.zh: 我深受奥斯卡·罗梅罗大主教以及这种解放神学思想的启发。

sentences.en: And I was...
sentences.zh: 我当时……

sentences.en: Which is a Catholic idea that you help the poor, that you, you know, try and give liberation through spiritual teaching.
sentences.zh: 这是一种天主教思想，即帮助穷人，通过精神教导来给予人们解放。

sentences.en: And it was very popular in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 这在20世纪80年代非常流行。

sentences.en: And he was assassinated.
sentences.zh: 然后他被暗杀了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, I was not due for a vacation.
sentences.zh: 其实我当时并不需要度假。

sentences.en: I was fried.
sentences.zh: 我筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: I was tired.
sentences.zh: 我很累。

sentences.en: I wanted to go somewhere with my family.
sentences.zh: 我想和家人去某个地方。

sentences.en: And we were going to dream it about Mazatlan.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在幻想着去马萨特兰。

sentences.en: And to be honest, a pristine stretch of tropical beach swept free of local riffraff.
sentences.zh: 老实说，就是去一片原始的热带海滩，把当地的社会闲杂人等都清扫干净。

sentences.en: Little plastic straps on our wrist so we can get all the drinks we want without dirtying our fingers with the local currency.
sentences.zh: 手腕上戴着小塑料带，这样我们就能畅饮各种饮品，而不用让当地货币弄脏我们的手指。

sentences.en: It was going to be a beautiful, hedonistic, relaxing vacation on a beach in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 那将是一场美好、享乐主义、令人放松的墨西哥海滩度假。

sentences.en: And then my friend said, it's the 25th anniversary of the assassination of Archbishop Romero.
sentences.zh: 然后我的朋友说，今年是奥梅罗大主教遇刺25周年。

sentences.en: We're going to march on the streets of San Salvador.
sentences.zh: 我们要去圣萨尔瓦多的街头游行。

sentences.en: You want to join us?
sentences.zh: 你想加入我们吗？

sentences.en: And I told my family, I'm going to be no fun on the beach.
sentences.zh: 我对家人说，我要是去海滩肯定一点意思也没有。

sentences.en: And it was one of the most valuable travel experiences I've ever had to be there on the streets of San Salvador, eating beans and rice one day and rice and beans the next,
sentences.zh: 那是我经历过的最珍贵的旅行体验之一，身处圣萨尔瓦多的街头，第一天吃着豆子配米饭，第二天吃着米饭配豆子，

sentences.en: covered with bug bites, marching with peasants to remember a slain leader.
sentences.zh: 身上被虫子咬得全是包，和农民们一起游行，纪念一位被杀害的领袖。

sentences.en: I was in my glory as a traveler there.
sentences.zh: 作为一个旅行者，我当时感到无上光荣。

sentences.en: It added so much to my enthusiasm for getting out and embracing the world in all of its truth.
sentences.zh: 这极大地激发了我走出去、拥抱真实世界的全部热情。

sentences.en: But that's a choice you have to make.
sentences.zh: 但这是一种你必须自己做出的选择。

sentences.en: And these days, Lulu, I'm in this sort of thing in my teaching where I remind people there's three kinds of travel.
sentences.zh: 而如今，Lulu，我在教学中常常提醒人们，旅行有三种。

sentences.en: You can travel as a tourist, a traveler, or a pilgrim.
sentences.zh: 你可以作为游客、旅行者或朝圣者去旅行。

sentences.en: And you don't need to be all of one or all of the other.
sentences.zh: 你不需要完全成为其中一种。

sentences.en: And what I like to do is free people and inspire people to mix it up.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢做的是解放人们的思想，激发他们将这些结合起来。

sentences.en: And that's an opportunity that even tourists, who's going to do all the silly Instagram posing that you were alluding to earlier, you can have a little bit of both.
sentences.zh: 即使是那些会摆出你刚才提到的各种愚蠢Instagram拍照姿势的游客，也有机会做到这两者的结合。

sentences.en: And that makes your trip much, much richer.
sentences.zh: 这会让你的旅程丰富得多。

sentences.en: You said three ways that you can travel.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说有三种旅行方式。

sentences.en: You can travel as a touriSt.
sentences.zh: 你可以作为游客去旅行。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: A traveler.
sentences.zh: 作为旅行者。

sentences.en: And then the third one was as a pilgrim.
sentences.zh: 然后第三种是作为朝圣者。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Explain to me the third one.
sentences.zh: 给我解释一下第三种。

sentences.en: I get the distinction between the first two.
sentences.zh: 前两种的区别我懂。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, first of all, most travelers I know, they're proud to be known as a traveler as opposed to a touriSt.
sentences.zh: 首先，我认识的大多数旅行者，都以为自己被称为旅行者而感到自豪，而不是被叫作游客。

sentences.en: So that's the big thing.
sentences.zh: 这就是最大的不同。

sentences.en: I'm more thoughtful.
sentences.zh: 我更有深度。

sentences.en: I'm not just here to shop and get a selfie.
sentences.zh: 我来这里不只是为了购物和拍自拍。

sentences.en: I'm here to immerse myself in the culture and learn.
sentences.zh: 我是来沉浸在文化中并进行学习的。

sentences.en: That is a traveler, to become a temporary local.
sentences.zh: 这才是旅行者，去成为一个暂时的当地人。

sentences.en: A traveler learns about the world.
sentences.zh: 旅行者了解世界。

sentences.en: But I think a pilgrim learns about themself.
sentences.zh: 但我认为朝圣者了解的是自己。

sentences.en: And you learn about yourself by leaving your home and looking at it from a distance.
sentences.zh: 你通过离开家并从远处审视它来了解自己。

sentences.en: You learn about yourself, I think, by trying to get close to God in your travels.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你在旅途中通过努力接近上帝来了解自己。

sentences.en: I mean, for me, the greatest church is walking on a ridge high in the Alps.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对我来说，最伟大的教堂就是在阿尔卑斯山的高山脊上徒步。

sentences.en: I just, the last thing a Lutheran's going to do is raise their arms to the heavens, you know.
sentences.zh: 路德教徒最不可能做的事就是向苍穹举起双手，你知道的。

sentences.en: But I feel like doing that when I'm top of an Alp.
sentences.zh: 但当我站在阿尔卑斯山顶时，我真有这种冲动。

sentences.en: You just feel so good.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉太棒了。

sentences.en: And you just feel like this world is such a beautiful place.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得这个世界是如此美丽。

sentences.en: And it's filled with beautiful people.
sentences.zh: 这里到处都是美好的人。

sentences.en: And nature is so fragile.
sentences.zh: 大自然又是如此脆弱。

sentences.en: And it's just such a delight and a blessing.
sentences.zh: 这真是一种喜悦和赐福。

sentences.en: It changes you.
sentences.zh: 这会改变你。

sentences.en: And it becomes pretty clear when you travel that we're all in this together.
sentences.zh: 当你去旅行时，你会发现我们都在同一条船上，这变得相当清晰。

sentences.en: I'm listening to you talk, and the philosophy is beautiful.
sentences.zh: 听你这么说，这种哲学太美妙了。

sentences.en: This idea of communion with the world, with connection with other people.
sentences.zh: 这种与世界共鸣、与他人连接的理念。

sentences.en: But there is a shift happening in the world right now, I think, towards isolationism, nativism, a fundamental suspicion of difference.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，现在的世界正在发生一种转变，走向孤立主义、本土主义，以及对差异的根本怀疑。

sentences.en: We're in a world that travels more than it ever has.
sentences.zh: 我们生活在一个比以往任何时候都更常旅行的世界里。

sentences.en: And yet, what seems to be happening is not what you would hope.
sentences.zh: 然而，发生的似乎并不是你所期望的那样。

sentences.en: And I'm just wondering what you make of those changes.
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，你如何看待这些变化？

sentences.en: More people are traveling than ever before, but there's not more transformational travel than ever before.
sentences.zh: 旅行的人比以往任何时候都多，但具有变革意义的旅行却并没有增加。

sentences.en: There's this superficial Instagram trip advisor kind of travel.
sentences.zh: 现在都是那种肤浅的、只为发Instagram和TripAdvisor猫途鹰的旅行。

sentences.en: Where you find, it's very interesting.
sentences.zh: 你会发现一个很有趣的现象。

sentences.en: In Europe, I find different places where suddenly, inexplicably, there's a mob of people.
sentences.zh: 在欧洲，我发现有些地方突然莫名其妙地聚集了一群人。

sentences.en: And what's going on?
sentences.zh: 怎么回事？

sentences.en: Oh, that's where everybody stands to get their selfie with the Matterhorn behind them.
sentences.zh: 哦，大家都站在那里，以马特洪峰为背景拍自拍照。

sentences.en: I was just in Zermatt.
sentences.zh: 我刚去过采尔马特。

sentences.en: And there's a construction project going on.
sentences.zh: 那里正在进行一个建筑项目。

sentences.en: And I asked the locals there in this little Swiss town below the Matterhorn, what are they building here?
sentences.zh: 我问那些马特洪峰脚下小瑞士镇的当地人，他们在这里建什么？

sentences.en: Well, the Instagram people were clogging the bridge, so people couldn't cross the bridge when they're going to work.
sentences.zh: 原来是Instagram的游客把桥给堵了，导致人们上班都无法过桥。

sentences.en: So they could get a photograph of them at the right hour with the Matterhorn.
sentences.zh: 为了能在正确的时间拍到一张以马特洪峰为背景的照片。

sentences.en: So we're making a platform so they can actually stand there and not obstruct traffic.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正在造一个平台，好让他们能站在上面，而不会阻碍交通。

sentences.en: It's beyond me.
sentences.zh: 这简直匪夷所思。

sentences.en: I don't get it.
sentences.zh: 我无法理解。

sentences.en: But that's sort of something that is hijacking the possible value of travel.
sentences.zh: 但这正是那种正在蚕食旅行潜在价值的现象。

sentences.en: But maybe it's good because it just gets people out there.
sentences.zh: 但也许这也不错，因为它至少能把人们吸引到户外去。

sentences.en: But isn't that what a guidebook is, ultimately?
sentences.zh: 但说到底，旅游指南不就是这样的吗？

sentences.en: It's, I mean, they're just placing value on a different thing, which is an image and a place.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们只是把价值放在了不同的事物上，也就是影像和地点。

sentences.en: But, I mean, a guidebook points you to a certain direction and tells you this is the thing that you need to go do in this particular place.
sentences.zh: 不过，旅游指南会为你指明一个方向，告诉你在这个特定地方有哪些非去不可的事情。

sentences.en: Well, a good guidebook, I think, would tell you about why you want to go there, other than to take a picture to show off to your friends on social media.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得一本好的旅游指南会告诉你为什么要特意去那里，而不是为了拍张照片好在社交媒体上向朋友炫耀。

sentences.en: Do you think social media is ruining travel?
sentences.zh: 你觉得社交媒体正在毁掉旅行吗？

sentences.en: I'm thinking about how most people I know, especially younger people, get their travel recommendations from TikTok and from Instagram.
sentences.zh: 我在想，我认识的大多数人，尤其是年轻人，他们的旅行推荐都是从TikTok和Instagram上获取的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I don't think it's ruining travel, but I do think there's, you know, when I started traveling, there was a shortage of information.
sentences.zh: 我不认为它毁了旅行，但我确实觉得，你知道的，我刚开始旅行时，信息是匮乏的。

sentences.en: Um, now there's too much information.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在信息太多了。

sentences.en: Anybody can be a travel writer with social media.
sentences.zh: 有了社交媒体，任何人都可以成为旅游作家。

sentences.en: And people are, there's this sort of spirit that, oh yeah, crowdsourcing.
sentences.zh: 人们有一种心态，哦对，就是众包。

sentences.en: I just want to know what everybody's doing on TripAdvisor, and then that's what I'm going to do.
sentences.zh: 我只想知道大家在TripAdvisor上都在做什么，然后我也要做什么。

sentences.en: Um, and younger travelers, I think, are more enamored with that, uh, crowdsourcing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得年轻的旅行者更迷恋那种众包方式。

sentences.en: I'm more tuned into having a trusted, um, expert that's been doing this for years that goes there and, you know, his or her style.
sentences.zh: 我更倾向于找一个值得信赖、多年来一直从事这项工作、亲自去过那里并且有自己独特风格的专家。

sentences.en: And, uh, they become your scout.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，它们成了你的向导。

sentences.en: Um, and now we got AI, which, um, is going to be a challenge for people in the future to know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在我们有了人工智能，嗯，这对未来的人来说将是一个挑战，让他们去分辨，

sentences.en: is this real information or is this computer-generated information that's going to shape my trip?
sentences.zh: 这是真实的信息，还是将要塑造我的旅行的计算机生成的信息？

sentences.en: Uh, so, um, now there's, uh, the challenge of people sorting through these options.
sentences.zh: 呃，所以，嗯，现在人们面临着在这些选项中进行筛选的挑战。

sentences.en: And, um, that will kind of distinguish travelers going forward in a lot of ways, I think.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，我认为这在很多方面将区分出未来的旅行者。

sentences.en: You've got this problem now, Lulu, that everybody's going to the same places at the same time.
sentences.zh: 露露，你现在遇到了这个问题，每个人都在同一时间去同一个地方。

sentences.en: This is a, uh, becoming its own little, um, making it more and more extreme of a storm of public understanding.
sentences.zh: 这，呃，正在变成它自己的一股小潮流，嗯，让公众理解的狂潮变得越来越极端。

sentences.en: It's in Europe over tourism, um, and Barcelona residents this summer were squirting visitors with water guns and chanting things like tourists go home.
sentences.zh: 欧洲正面临过度旅游的问题，嗯，今年夏天巴塞罗那的居民用水枪喷射游客，并高喊“游客回家”之类的口号。

sentences.en: And this is driven to a, to a certain degree by social media and, and bucket list travel.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上是由社交媒体和愿望清单旅行所驱动的。

sentences.en: Everybody has to do this, they have to do that.
sentences.zh: 每个人都必须做这个，他们必须做那个。

sentences.en: Um, I like to say in my lectures, there's two IQs of European travelers, those who wait in lines and those who don't wait in lines.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我喜欢在演讲中说，欧洲旅行者有两种智商，一种是排队的，一种是不排队的。

sentences.en: I've seen people walk by something and they see a line and they get in it before they know what the line's for.
sentences.zh: 我见过有人从某样东西旁边走过，他们看到一条队，在搞清楚这队是干嘛之前就排上去了。

sentences.en: Um, I go the other direction when I see a line like that, or I realize that I don't need to put up with this line.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我看到这样的队伍时，我会朝相反的方向走，或者我意识到我不需要忍受这个队伍。

sentences.en: There's a lot of, um, less trendy places that are never crowded.
sentences.zh: 有很多，嗯，不那么时髦且从不拥挤的地方。

sentences.en: The Colosseum in Rome is, is chaos.
sentences.zh: 罗马的斗兽场是，是一片混乱。

sentences.en: You've got a book in advance or you're not going to get in there.
sentences.zh: 你必须提前订票，否则你进不去。

sentences.en: Uh, 10 minute, 15 minute walk away.
sentences.zh: 呃，步行10分钟、15分钟的地方。

sentences.en: The Baths of Caracalla are just as impressive example of Roman engineering.
sentences.zh: 卡拉卡拉浴场同样是罗马工程令人印象深刻的典范。

sentences.en: Beautiful, beautiful, peaceful place, never crowded at all.
sentences.zh: 美丽、美丽、宁静的地方，一点也不拥挤。

sentences.en: So one thing we're doing in our guidebooks now is recognizing that these crowd problems are going to get worse and worse as more and more people travel and more and more people travel with agendas driven by crowdsourcing and social media.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在导游书中正在做的一件事是认识到，随着越来越多的人去旅行，以及越来越多的人带着由众包和社交媒体驱动的议程去旅行，这些拥挤问题将变得越来越严重。

sentences.en: And they're all going to be going to the same places, essentially ignoring the other places.
sentences.zh: 而且他们基本上都会去相同的地方，而忽略其他地方。

sentences.en: And, um,
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，

sentences.en: Europe is wide open if you can just break yourself free from the need to see the place that everybody wants to see a photograph of and immerse yourself in other dimensions of the culture.
sentences.zh: 如果你能让自己摆脱去看每个人都想拍张照片的地方的需求，并让自己沉浸在文化的其他维度中，欧洲是完全向你敞开的。

sentences.en: Is there anywhere that you regret having popularized?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪个地方是你后悔将其实现大众化的？

sentences.en: That's a very interesting question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的问题。

sentences.en: Uh, and, uh, first of all, I have a big impact on a, a few places that I've really made my marquee places, what I call back doors.
sentences.zh: 呃，而且，首先，我对几个我真正打造成招牌的地方有着巨大的影响，我称之为后门旅游点。

sentences.en: Um, and the Italian Riviera, the Cinque Terre is a good example of that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，意大利里维埃拉的五渔村就是一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: Um, and when I first went, there was one of the poorest parts of Italy and you could hardly get there by, by car.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我第一次去的时候，那是意大利最贫穷的地区之一，你几乎很难开车到达那里。

sentences.en: And it was just forgotten.
sentences.zh: 而且它几乎被遗忘了。

sentences.en: These amazing little villages surrounded by vineyards on the Italian Riviera.
sentences.zh: 这些令人惊叹的小村庄坐落在意大利里维埃拉，四周环绕着葡萄园。

sentences.en: And you walked to each of them.
sentences.zh: 你可以步行去每一个村子。

sentences.en: Each one had a castle.
sentences.zh: 每一个村子都有一座城堡。

sentences.en: Each one had beautiful, um, zero kilometer eating opportunities.
sentences.zh: 每一个村子都有美丽的、嗯，零公里餐饮机会。

sentences.en: You know, that's the thing in Italy where you'd eat zero kilometer, everything grown right there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是意大利的一种特色，你会吃零公里的食物，所有东西都在当地种植。

sentences.en: Um, and, uh, I discovered it for American travelers and I raved about it and I made a TV show and I sent everybody there with my books.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且，呃，我为美国旅行者发现了它，我对它大加赞赏，我制作了一个电视节目，并用我的书把每个人都送到了那里。

sentences.en: And suddenly people are wearing t-shirts that says, I've seen, you know, Rome, Venice, Florence, and the Cinque Terre.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，人们穿着印有“我见过，你知道的，罗马、威尼斯、佛罗伦萨和五渔村”的T恤。

sentences.en: It's right up there with those guys.
sentences.zh: 它和那些地方齐名了。

sentences.en: And, uh, I go there and it's crowded, admittedly.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，我去那里时，不可否认，它很拥挤。

sentences.en: It's commercial.
sentences.zh: 它很商业化。

sentences.en: It's greedy.
sentences.zh: 它很贪婪。

sentences.en: Now the local people are retired in the big city and they've hired younger people, often from other countries, to run their little B&Bs.
sentences.zh: 现在当地人在大城市退休了，他们雇用了通常来自其他国家的年轻人来经营他们的小B&B民宿。

sentences.en: And you've got all sorts of cute little boutique shops and, uh, you know, um, experiences on the Riviera.
sentences.zh: 里维埃拉上有各种各样可爱的小精品店，还有，你知道的，嗯，各种体验。

sentences.en: But the magic is still there.
sentences.zh: 但那种魔力依然存在。

sentences.en: It's morphed and now they are affluent towns instead of poor towns.
sentences.zh: 它已经变了样，现在它们成了富裕的小镇，而不是贫穷的小镇。

sentences.en: And now the new generation doesn't even want to work in the fields.
sentences.zh: 现在新一代甚至不想在田里工作了。

sentences.en: They're just, they turn their back on their vineyards that they inherit from their parents.
sentences.zh: 他们只是，他们背弃了从父母那里继承来的葡萄园。

sentences.en: They used to be beloved.
sentences.zh: 它们过去是备受热爱的。

sentences.en: So wait, I'm hearing a lot of different things.
sentences.zh: 等等，我听到了很多不同的说法。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: How do you feel about that transformation?
sentences.zh: 你对这种转变有何感想？

sentences.en: Because there's the good stuff, they're affluent.
sentences.zh: 因为有好的一面，他们变富裕了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But then there's the bad stuff that their way of life is changing, which is at the center of this industry that you've given your life to.
sentences.zh: 但也有不好的一面，他们的生活方式正在改变，而这正是你奉献了一生的这个行业的核心所在。

sentences.en: I wish Europe was an oasis with women on, with jugs on their heads getting water.
sentences.zh: 我希望欧洲是一片绿洲，有顶着水罐取水的妇女。

sentences.en: You know, that idyllic old world thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那种田园诗般的旧世界景象。

sentences.en: But it's not.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: And, um, tourism is a big part of the economy.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，旅游业是经济的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: Um, and I don't know, it's, I'm kind of perplexed about it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道，我对此感到有些困惑。

sentences.en: Occasionally I find a place that cannot handle the crowds and I will not write it up.
sentences.zh: 偶尔我发现一个无法承受人潮的地方，我就不会把它写进书里。

sentences.en: You know, it's just too fragile.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那里太脆弱了。

sentences.en: Occasionally I find a place that doesn't want the crowds.
sentences.zh: 偶尔我发现一个不欢迎游客的地方。

sentences.en: That's pretty rare, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这相当罕见。

sentences.en: And I don't write it up because I don't want to send people to a place where they're not welcome.
sentences.zh: 而且我不会把它写进去，因为我不想把人们送到一个他们不受欢迎的地方。

sentences.en: That's so interesting that this is, that you have to consider that now.
sentences.zh: 这太有趣了，现在你居然必须考虑到这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, and, but generally, I've got to be honest, I'm, I'm like, um, I'm, I'm,
sentences.zh: 是的，但是总的来说，老实说，我，我像是，嗯，我，我，

sentences.en: I'm the hired hand of my readers to find the best places over there and give them what they need to enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 我是我读者的受雇帮手，去那里寻找最好的地方，并为他们提供享受这些地方所需的东西。

sentences.en: I would say there's good tourism and bad tourism from the point of view of people who live in these towns.
sentences.zh: 我想从这些城镇居民的角度来看，有好的旅游业和坏的旅游业。

sentences.en: And the people who are angry with the tourists are not angry with my kind of travelers who come in and stay in a hotel and buy dinner and are curious about the culture.
sentences.zh: 生游客气的人并不是在对我的那种旅行者生气，他们进来住酒店，买晚餐，并且对文化充满好奇。

sentences.en: What they don't like is people that blitz in on mass tourism by cruise ships or tour buses that stay in a big modern hotel outside of the city.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢的是那种乘游轮或旅游巴士进行大规模闪电式旅游的人，他们住在城外的大型现代酒店里。

sentences.en: And the people don't leave anything in the town except their congestion.
sentences.zh: 这些人除了留下拥堵之外，什么也没在这个小镇留下。

sentences.en: Uh, there's consequences of travel.
sentences.zh: 呃，旅行是有后果的。

sentences.en: We have to, uh, deal with the white elephant in the room and that would be climate change and how travelers contribute to that.
sentences.zh: 我们必须，呃，正视房间里的大象，那就是气候变化以及旅行者是如何对此负有责任的。

sentences.en: And that could be a whole nother discussion.
sentences.zh: 那可以成为另一个完全不同的讨论。

sentences.en: But my challenge is to recognize that people can travel, people can contribute to climate change, and people can come home having just exacerbated the diff,
sentences.zh: 但我的挑战是认识到人们可以旅行，人们可以促成气候变化，人们回家时可能只是加剧了差异，

sentences.en: the gap between them and the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 他们与世界其他地方之间的鸿沟。

sentences.en: I am going to talk to you again.
sentences.zh: 我会再次与你交谈。

sentences.en: But in the time we have left, I want to return to the question of the world and how it's changing.
sentences.zh: 但在剩下的时间里，我想回到关于世界及其如何变化的问题上。

sentences.en: Because you responded to my question about nativism and fear of difference by talking about social media.
sentences.zh: 因为你通过谈论社交媒体来回应我关于本土主义和对差异的恐惧的问题。

sentences.en: But I think there's something more fundamental going on.
sentences.zh: 但我认为有更根本的事情正在发生。

sentences.en: I mean, I've sat at the foot of melting glaciers in the Andes with someone who is seeing it and says, I don't believe in climate change.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我曾和某个人一起坐在安第斯山脉融化的冰川脚下，他亲眼看到这一幕，却说：“我不相信气候变化。”

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Perhaps you might be overstating the transformative power of this thing that you do.
sentences.zh: 也许你可能高估了你所做的事情的变革力量。

sentences.en: It's remarkable to me how people can travel and not be impacted by what they see.
sentences.zh: 令我惊讶的是，人们怎么能去旅行却不受他们所见所闻的影响。

sentences.en: My challenge is to try to inspire people to be thoughtful.
sentences.zh: 我的挑战是努力启发人们去进行深入思考。

sentences.en: And the most frightened people are the people who've never traveled, whose worldview is shaped by commercial news media.
sentences.zh: 而最害怕的人是从未旅行过的人，他们的世界观是由商业新闻媒体塑造的。

sentences.en: And the people that are not afraid are the people who have been out there and met the enemy.
sentences.zh: 而不害怕的人是那些走出去并与“敌人”会面过的人。

sentences.en: And I think my most powerful travel experiences have been going places where I'm not supposed to go.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我最有力量的旅行经历是去那些我不该去的地方。

sentences.en: Cuba, Palestine, Iran.
sentences.zh: 古巴、巴勒斯坦、伊朗。

sentences.en: You can't always go to these kind of places.
sentences.zh: 你不能总是去这种地方。

sentences.en: I would never go to places that are dangerous.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会去危险的地方。

sentences.en: But I've had great travel experiences in places where you'd be surprised I've gone to.
sentences.zh: 但我在一些你会感到惊讶我曾去过的地方有过很棒的旅行经历。

sentences.en: The friendliest people, the most curious people, the people that need to meet me and I need to meet them.
sentences.zh: 最友善的人，最好奇的人，那些需要见我而我也需要见他们的人。

sentences.en: When they meet me, it's tougher for their propaganda to demonize me.
sentences.zh: 当他们见到我时，他们的宣传机器就更难把我妖魔化了。

sentences.en: And when I meet them, it's tougher for my country's propaganda to dehumanize them.
sentences.zh: 而当我见到他们时，我国家的宣传机器就更难把他们非人化了。

sentences.en: It's a powerful thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件很有力量的事。

sentences.en: We become less afraid of each other.
sentences.zh: 我们对彼此不那么恐惧了。

sentences.en: The flip side of fear is understanding, and we gain understanding when we travel.
sentences.zh: 恐惧的另一面是理解，我们在旅行中获得了理解。

sentences.en: And that alone makes travel a worthwhile experience.
sentences.zh: 仅此一点就让旅行成为一次有价值的经历。

sentences.en: And when it's done thoughtfully, we come home and we live our lives as more thankful than ever that we're American citizens, but also better citizens of the planet.
sentences.zh: 当深思熟虑地完成这一切时，我们回到家中，比以往任何时候都更加庆幸自己是美国公民，同时也成为了更好的地球公民，并以此生活。

sentences.en: And that just makes my life richer.
sentences.zh: 这只会让我的生活更丰富。

sentences.en: It makes it more filled with truth.
sentences.zh: 它让生活充满了更多真理。

sentences.en: And it gives more colors to my palate.
sentences.zh: 它给我的调色板增添了更多的色彩。

sentences.en: I just, I'm just really thankful for that kind of a souvenir.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我真的非常感谢能有这样一种纪念品。

sentences.en: After the break, I call Rick back to ask about what he's sacrificed for a life on the road.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我给里克回了电话，询问他为路上的生活牺牲了什么。

sentences.en: There's regrets.
sentences.zh: 是有遗憾的。

sentences.en: It's not, it has not been good for relationships with loved ones.
sentences.zh: 这并不是，这对与挚爱之人的关系并没有好处。

sentences.en: And I, I'm aware of that.
sentences.zh: 而我，我意识到了这一点。

sentences.en: And I'm, in a way, I'm sad about it, but you have to make a choice.
sentences.zh: 而且在某种程度上，我为此感到难过，但你必须做出选择。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games.
sentences.zh: 我创作了《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一——《连线》（Connections）。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马苏尔斯基，我每天创作《拼写蜜蜂》（Spelling Bee）和《字母宝盒》（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色觉联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》游戏是由像你刚才听到的人这样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Hey, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 嘿，露露。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你最近怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: It's early in Seattle.
sentences.zh: 西雅图现在还很早。

sentences.en: So far, I'm great.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我状态极佳。

sentences.en: I see that you're at home right now.
sentences.zh: 我看到你现在在家。

sentences.en: I want to ask you about your home, because you have traveled all over the world.
sentences.zh: 我想问问你关于你的家，因为你曾去世界各地旅行。

sentences.en: And yet, you have always lived in the place where you grew up.
sentences.zh: 然而，你却一直住在你长大的地方。

sentences.en: Why is that?
sentences.zh: 这是为什么？

sentences.en: I don't think I have an agenda to live in the place I grew up.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我并没有一定要住在自己长大的地方的打算。

sentences.en: It's just, I'm settled here, you know.
sentences.zh: 只是，我在安顿在这里了，你知道的。

sentences.en: I look out my window right now, and I can see what was my junior high school.
sentences.zh: 我此时正看着窗外，能看到以前我的初中。

sentences.en: And I think I've got to show it to you.
sentences.zh: 我想我得把它展示给你看看。

sentences.en: There you go.
sentences.zh: 给你看。

sentences.en: Can you see?
sentences.zh: 你能看到吗？

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: That's an amazing view.
sentences.zh: 那真是个惊艳的视野。

sentences.en: And indeed, I can see your school.
sentences.zh: 而且确实，我能看到你的学校。

sentences.en: This is the field.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个操场。

sentences.en: I just had to run around that track when I was in seventh grade.
sentences.zh: 我在七年级的时候不得不绕着那个跑道跑步。

sentences.en: Most people would not want that memory infused.
sentences.zh: 大多数人不会希望那种记忆被融入其中。

sentences.en: No, it's a bad memory.
sentences.zh: 不，那是段糟糕的记忆。

sentences.en: That's a bad memory.
sentences.zh: 那是段糟糕的记忆。

sentences.en: I've always worked on the same street.
sentences.zh: 我一直都在同一条街上工作。

sentences.en: I've worked at four addresses on the same street, four blocks up the street from the ferry dock.
sentences.zh: 我在同一条街上的四个不同门牌号工作过，距离渡轮码头往上四个街区。

sentences.en: And I can walk there in seven minutes from my home.
sentences.zh: 从我家步行七分钟就能到那里。

sentences.en: This is where I've got friends.
sentences.zh: 这就是我有朋友的地方。

sentences.en: This is where I know the bar.
sentences.zh: 这就是我熟悉那个酒吧的地方。

sentences.en: This is where I go for my old-fashioned American-style greasy spoon breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是我去吃老式美式家常早餐的地方。

sentences.en: This is my home.
sentences.zh: 这是我的家。

sentences.en: Rick, I did want to ask you about something pretty significant in your life.
sentences.zh: 瑞克，我确实想问你一些关于你生活中相当重要的事情。

sentences.en: You've been very open about receiving a diagnosis of prostate cancer.
sentences.zh: 对于自己被诊断出患有前列腺癌，你一直非常坦然。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你现在情况怎么样？

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢谢你。

sentences.en: I'm doing as well as you can be doing when you have prostate cancer.
sentences.zh: 得了前列腺癌，我现在的状态能有多好就有多好吧。

sentences.en: You know, a month ago, I said goodbye to my prostate.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，一个月前，我和我的前列腺告别了。

sentences.en: And I see it as a journey.
sentences.zh: 我把它看作是一段旅程。

sentences.en: I don't speak the language.
sentences.zh: 我不会说当地的语言。

sentences.en: I don't know exactly where it's going.
sentences.zh: 我并不确切知道它会通往何方。

sentences.en: I'm not in control of the itinerary.
sentences.zh: 行程不由我掌控。

sentences.en: I want to tackle it with what I consider a traveler's mindset.
sentences.zh: 我想以我认为的旅行者心态来应对它。

sentences.en: But it's scary at the same time.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时这也挺吓人的。

sentences.en: You know, my prognosis is very good.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的预后非常好。

sentences.en: If you're going to get cancer, prostate's a good kind of cancer to get.
sentences.zh: 如果要得癌症的话，前列腺癌算是一种不错的癌症。

sentences.en: And it's interesting to me.
sentences.zh: 而且这对我来说挺有意思的。

sentences.en: It hasn't gotten me down.
sentences.zh: 它并没有把我打倒。

sentences.en: I'm kind of having, not fun, but I'm having a learning experience.
sentences.zh: 我某种程度上算是在经历，也不能说是好玩，但这是一次学习的经历。

sentences.en: I didn't really want to be an expert on incontinence.
sentences.zh: 我其实并不想成为失禁方面的专家。

sentences.en: But I'm going to get through it.
sentences.zh: 但我会挺过去的。

sentences.en: And people are coming out of the woodworks telling me about their experience.
sentences.zh: 人们纷纷涌来向我诉说他们的经历。

sentences.en: One of the most commented on and shared posts I've ever had on Facebook was when I shared my experience there.
sentences.zh: 我在脸书上发表过获得评论最多、分享最多的帖子之一，就是我分享自己经历的那一次。

sentences.en: And it was a very, very positive thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件非常非常积极的事情。

sentences.en: I've always thought it's important not to keep these things secret, to be embarrassed about anything.
sentences.zh: 我一直认为，把这些事情保密、对任何事感到尴尬是很重要的。

sentences.en: When I was a teenager, that was a long time ago, my mom had some kind of depression.
sentences.zh: 当我还是个青少年的时候，那是很久以前了，我妈妈患有某种抑郁症。

sentences.en: And they were fiddling around trying to find the right kind of
sentences.zh: 他们当时在摸索着想找到合适种类的

sentences.en: antidepressant medicine for her and so on.
sentences.zh: 抗抑郁药物等等。

sentences.en: And I know that there's a lot of depression in our society.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们社会中有大量的抑郁症患者。

sentences.en: And even as a teenager, I felt like, I can't keep this a secret.
sentences.zh: 甚至早在青少年时期，我就觉得，我不能把这当作秘密。

sentences.en: We've got to share it with people so that when they have depression in their family, they will be more open about it and sharing and not be alone and afraid, but be in community.
sentences.zh: 我们必须与人分享，这样当他们家里有人患有抑郁症时，他们就能更加开放地去分享，而不会感到孤独和害怕，而是融入社区。

sentences.en: And, you know, I've had a lot of prayers and a lot of thoughts, thoughts and prayers and warm feelings and all that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我收到了很多祈祷、很多心意，心意、祈祷、温暖的感觉以及所有这些。

sentences.en: And it almost has a tangible value.
sentences.zh: 这几乎具有一种有形实在的价值。

sentences.en: It fills the sails that motor me through this journey.
sentences.zh: 它鼓起风帆，驱动着我度过这段旅程。

sentences.en: And I'm really thankful for it.
sentences.zh: 对此我真的非常感激。

sentences.en: Has it given you more of an urgency to do things you haven't done before?
sentences.zh: 这有没有让你产生一种更迫切的愿望去做以前没做过的事？

sentences.en: No, but it gives me an awareness of what you might regret when you're wrapping up your life.
sentences.zh: 没有，但它让我意识到，当你的人生走到尾声时，你可能会对什么感到后悔。

sentences.en: You know, you think about that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你会去思考这一点。

sentences.en: And it does make me consider and reconsider, you know, my priorities.
sentences.zh: 这确实让我思考并重新思考，你知道的，我的人生排序。

sentences.en: And be more mindful.
sentences.zh: 并变得更加正念。

sentences.en: Be more mindful, yeah.
sentences.zh: 变得更加正念，是的。

sentences.en: I just want to stay for a moment with that idea of regret.
sentences.zh: 我想在这个关于遗憾的想法上停留一会儿。

sentences.en: I mean, what happened, the sacrifices of being on the road so much?
sentences.zh: 我是说，发生了什么，为了在路上奔波做出那么多牺牲意味着什么？

sentences.en: Because you have spent such a huge portion of your life going out elsewhere and discovering and exploring.
sentences.zh: 因为你生命中的很大一部分都花在了外出、发现和探索上。

sentences.en: There's regrets.
sentences.zh: 是有遗憾的。

sentences.en: It has not been good for my family.
sentences.zh: 这对我的家庭没有好处。

sentences.en: I got divorced.
sentences.zh: 我离婚了。

sentences.en: It's not been great for relationships with loved ones.
sentences.zh: 这对与挚爱之人的关系也没什么大好作用。

sentences.en: And it's not, it's a choice you have to make.
sentences.zh: 而且它不是，这是你必须做出的选择。

sentences.en: You know, I would love to be the person I was before I was a travel writer.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我很想成为当旅行作家之前的那个自己。

sentences.en: I would have had a very, very beautiful life being a piano teacher and coming home every night for dinner
sentences.zh: 如果当个钢琴老师，每天晚上回家吃晚饭

sentences.en: and mowing the lawn and joining clubs and, you know, being regular and reliable.
sentences.zh: 修剪草坪，加入俱乐部，你知道的，过着普通而可靠的生活，我会拥有非常非常美好的一生。

sentences.en: Um, but I've chosen a different path and this is a path that, um, is, it's a mission for me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我选择了一条不同的路，这条路，嗯，对我来说是一项使命。

sentences.en: And, uh, I don't spend a lot of time explaining to people why my values are the way they are.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，我不会花太多时间向别人解释为什么我的价值观是这样的。

sentences.en: My priorities are the way they are.
sentences.zh: 我的优先事项为什么是这样的。

sentences.en: This is something that it's not accidental.
sentences.zh: 这不是偶然发生的。

sentences.en: I've calculated it.
sentences.zh: 这是我权衡计算过的。

sentences.en: And I've got an opportunity to be what I consider extremely productive from, uh, helping people travel in a, in a constructive way.
sentences.zh: 我获得了机会，以我认为极具成效的方式，呃，帮助人们以一种，一种建设性的方式旅行。

sentences.en: And I choose that knowing it's not going to be without a coSt.
sentences.zh: 我选择这样做，深知它并非没有代价。

sentences.en: And, um, and I'm aware of that.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，我很清楚这一点。

sentences.en: And I'm, in a way I'm sad about it, but again, you have to make a choice.
sentences.zh: 而且，从某种意义上说我为此感到难过，但话又说回来，你必须做出选择。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Well, it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这很有意思。

sentences.en: You use two different words.
sentences.zh: 你用了两个不同的词。

sentences.en: One is mission and one is choice.
sentences.zh: 一个是使命，一个是选择。

sentences.en: I mean, mission sounds like it's a calling and that it doesn't feel like it's a choice, that it doesn't feel like it's optional.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，使命听起来像是一种召唤，感觉它不是一种选择，感觉它不是可有可无的。

sentences.en: Oh, that's interesting.
sentences.zh: 哦，这很有意思。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it relates to this idea that you have talked about with me, which is of being a pilgrim.
sentences.zh: 这与你曾跟我谈过的一个概念有关，那就是成为一名朝圣者。

sentences.en: Um, it seems like the way that you view your career has been infused with this sense of, of a calling of something greater than yourself that you're trying to do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，似乎你看待自己职业的方式融入了一种召唤感，一种超越自你本身的、你正试图去做的更伟大的事情。

sentences.en: It's almost a calling from a pastoral sense or something.
sentences.zh: 这几乎带有某种牧灵意义上的召唤之类的。

sentences.en: You know, this is why God put me here.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这就是上帝把我放在这里的原因。

sentences.en: And I, it gives me energy.
sentences.zh: 这给了我能量。

sentences.en: It's like breathing straight oxygen.
sentences.zh: 就像在直接吸氧一样。

sentences.en: And I wouldn't wish it on anybody, but it fits me and I would have it no other way.
sentences.zh: 我不会把这强加给任何人，但它适合我，而且我绝不会改变。

sentences.en: If you couldn't travel anymore or you had to travel differently because of age or sickness or something else, do you worry that that would be a big identity shift for you?
sentences.zh: 如果你不能再旅行了，或者由于年龄、疾病或其他原因你不得不以不同的方式旅行，你会担心那会成为你身份上的巨大转变吗？

sentences.en: I've thought about that.
sentences.zh: 我考虑过这个问题。

sentences.en: That's a very good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: And it's, it's, um, kind of cool to have to put it into words.
sentences.zh: 而且把它付诸言语，是一件，是一件，呃，挺酷的事。

sentences.en: My thoughts on that.
sentences.zh: 我对此的想法。

sentences.en: I would welcome the day, strangely, when I could not travel anymore because it would open a gate of things that I've not done because of my love for travel.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，我会欢迎不能再旅行的那一天的到来，因为那会为我打开一扇大门，去体验那些由于我对旅行的热爱而未能做的事情。

sentences.en: I've got a great piano sitting here.
sentences.zh: 我这里有一架很棒的钢琴。

sentences.en: I don't play it enough.
sentences.zh: 我弹得还不够多。

sentences.en: I've got a cabin in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 我在山里有一间小屋。

sentences.en: I've got an amazing girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 我有一个了不起的女友。

sentences.en: I've got a, um, a wonderful son and daughter and a grandson.
sentences.zh: 我有一个，呃，非常棒的儿子、女儿和外孙。

sentences.en: Uh, and if suddenly I couldn't do my work anymore, uh,
sentences.zh: 呃，如果突然间我不能再做我的工作了，呃，

sentences.en: I don't think I'd miss a beat, much as I love my work, much as I can neglect things that other people would think, boy,
sentences.zh: 我想我不会错过任何节奏，尽管我多么热爱我的工作，尽管我可能会忽视那些别人会觉得，天哪，

sentences.en: what a, what an odd character that you would not value that.
sentences.zh: 你竟然不珍视那个，真是个怪人。

sentences.en: Um, I would take it as good news that now I can turn a corner and do something else.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我会把它当作好消息，因为现在我可以转过弯去做别的事情了。

sentences.en: I would just, you know, be thankful that I had enough vigor left in me and my, uh, that I could, uh, enjoy it fully.
sentences.zh: 我只会，你知道的，心怀感激，因为我和我的，呃，还保留着足够的精力，能够，呃，充分享受它。

sentences.en: Um, you know, I, I, uh, took a one week hike around Mount Blanc with, uh, my girlfriend Shelly and, uh, I'm just, I love traveling with her and, uh,
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，我，我，呃，和我的女友雪莉一起在勃朗峰周围徒步了一周，呃，我就是，我喜欢和她一起旅行，呃，

sentences.en: and it was a great thing because hiking around Mount Blanc, there was no research I could do.
sentences.zh: 这是一件很棒的事情，因为在勃朗峰周围徒步，我什么研究也做不了。

sentences.en: I, I, I wasn't going to write a book about it.
sentences.zh: 我，我，我没打算写一本关于它的书。

sentences.en: I'm, I, it was just, and it was pushing me to the limit with, um, what I could do physically.
sentences.zh: 我，我，这只是，它把我身体能做到的极限推向了边缘。

sentences.en: And, uh, I was in a whole different world.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，我身处一个完全不同的世界。

sentences.en: I was in tune with different things in my body.
sentences.zh: 我和我身体里的不同事物保持着和谐同步。

sentences.en: I was taking time to do things that were not productive in, in this Rick Steves way that I'm so focused on.
sentences.zh: 我花时间去做那些在我如此专注的这种瑞克·斯特夫斯式的生活中毫无成效的事情。

sentences.en: And after that week, Lulu, I just thought, wow, I was so into something I didn't know I could be into.
sentences.zh: 而经过那一周之后，露露，我只是觉得，哇，我竟然深深地投入到了一件我不知道自己能投入的事情中。

sentences.en: A long distance hike with one person learning nothing of value really for my work.
sentences.zh: 一次长途徒步，只有一个人，实际上没有为我的工作学到任何有价值的东西。

sentences.en: Just realizing I could do it in this world, such a beautiful place to experience.
sentences.zh: 只是意识到我可以在这个世界上做到这一点，这是一个多么美丽、值得体验的地方啊。

sentences.en: And there are dimensions of experiencing this world that I have yet to try.
sentences.zh: 而且体验这个世界的维度还有很多我尚未尝试的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: What place, if I'm going to Europe, should I skip?
sentences.zh: 如果我要去欧洲，哪个地方我应该跳过？

sentences.en: And what place can't I miss?
sentences.zh: 哪个地方是我不能错过的？

sentences.en: I've stumped Rick Steves.
sentences.zh: 我把瑞克·斯特夫斯难倒了。

sentences.en: You've stumped Rick Steves.
sentences.zh: 你把瑞克·斯特夫斯难倒了。

sentences.en: Now I can, I can tell you what not to miss, but I'm thinking, what should you skip?
sentences.zh: 现在我可以，我可以告诉你什么不该错过，但我在想，你应该跳过什么？

sentences.en: Skip places with no artifacts.
sentences.zh: 跳过没有文物的那些地方。

sentences.en: In your sightseeing.
sentences.zh: 在你的观光行程中。

sentences.en: Places that are commercial gimmicks.
sentences.zh: 那些纯属商业噱头的地方。

sentences.en: The torture dungeon.
sentences.zh: 酷刑地牢。

sentences.en: The Leonardo exhibit.
sentences.zh: 达芬奇展览。

sentences.en: It's just a kit that people buy and they put it up and they charge people a lot of money to see it.
sentences.zh: 那只是一套人们买来组装好，然后向参观者收取大笔门票的展品。

sentences.en: That's what you skip.
sentences.zh: 那才是你应该跳过的。

sentences.en: Not because they're bad, but because when you go there you have less time and energy to do something else that's more valid.
sentences.zh: 倒不是因为它们不好，而是因为当你去那里时，你留给其他更有价值的事物的时间和精力就变少了。

sentences.en: And then the places to see, find a way to put yourself in a world of people where you're not a tourist, where you're not part of the economy,
sentences.zh: 然后要看的地方，想办法让自己置身于一个人们的世界里，在那里你不是游客，在那里你不属于旅游经济的一部分，

sentences.en: but where you're just kind of crashing the party.
sentences.zh: 而是有点像去那里不速之客般地闯入派对。

sentences.en: Go to a bingo parlor in Wales.
sentences.zh: 去威尔士的宾果游戏厅。

sentences.en: Sit on a bench in Sicily with a bunch of old retired guys.
sentences.zh: 和一群退休老头一起坐在西西里的长凳上。

sentences.en: Play backgammon in Turkey.
sentences.zh: 在土耳其玩双陆棋。

sentences.en: Get naked with a bunch of people in Finland in a sauna.
sentences.zh: 在芬兰的桑拿房里和一群人赤诚相见。

sentences.en: And you're sitting there and all you've got is wet hair plastered on Finland flesh, steam, beautiful wood, and a sense that you don't know what century you're in,
sentences.zh: 你坐在那里，身上唯一的只有贴在芬兰肉体上的湿头发、蒸汽、美丽的木头，以及一种你不知道自己身处哪个世纪的感觉，

sentences.en: but you know you're in Finland.
sentences.zh: 但你知道你身在芬兰。

sentences.en: Ha!
sentences.zh: 哈！

sentences.en: You've got to find those kind of moments.
